title: Localization properties of the etale residue colimit
statement: Localization properties of the etale residue colimit.

proof.text: Represent each colimit element by f at a triple t. The kernel of B -> kappa(q) -> K is q, since the field embedding is injective. Compatibility with psi therefore detects exactly membership in q.
If psi(x) is nonzero, its representative f is outside q. Refine to a triple where f is a unit and map that unit to the colimit. Cocone naturality identifies the image with x.
If psi(x)=0, its representative belongs to q. Refine until the image belongs to pB_s, then map its ideal membership to the colimit. Cocone naturality and the structural-map equation give x in pC.
For the reverse ideal inclusion, use the identity triple (R,id,p,chi). Its coprojection equals rho by h_rho, and the residue map kills p. Thus pC is contained in ker psi.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP; D2 proves the unchanged statement by representative, unit-refinement, and ideal-refinement reductions, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_colimit_localization (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)))) (hc : IsColimit c) (ρ : R ⟶ c.pt) (hρ : ∀ t, t.α ≫ c.ι.app t = ρ) (ψ : c.pt →+* K) (hψ : ∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom = ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom) : (∀ x : c.pt, ψ x ≠ 0 → IsUnit x) ∧ RingHom.ker ψ = p.asIdeal.map ρ.hom
